data.text:
Ooouch... My head’s getting stabbed by some icy sharp pain...!
But it’s so good I can’t just stop! I’m even getting addicted to the taste~♪
What’s that? You want to try some? NOPE! You’ve got your own, right?
You want it THAT much, huh? Ohhhkay.
Let’s do this then. If you come play together with me later, I’ll think about it~♪
WHOAH, you can stop nodding now, I get it! Then, it’s a promise!
Now here comes the plaaane~♪ Open wide~♡
But cheating is absolutely not allowed! My love is bigger than the ocean after all~♪
Ta-daaaan! How's my swimsuit? Does it suit me? The check pattern is cute, right?♪
You know... If we swap the syrup for liqueur...wouldn’t it taste WAAAY better?
Woah?! Just as I expected! Shaved ice with liqueur is sooo yummy! Am I a genius or what?
Ugh... I ate too much shaved ice and now I’m kinda getting a bit chilly...
Hey hey, let’s play in the sea before fishing! We’ll get into it after we’ve warmed up, c’mon!

The meat’s ready to be placed!
Ooh, I can hear that tantalizing sizzle of the meat being cooked by the flames~
Look at the meat juices overflowing!
How's the searing going? Is it ready? Is it ready yet?
Ta-daan! The meat’s done!
Man, I really love BBQ’s~♪ I’m so glad we built this place~♪
Huh? You’ll cook some more for me?! Big thanks!
I’ll have it rare this time, then. Super rare, okay? I’m counting on you~♪
The engine’s fire mustn’t go out! We’ve gotta enjoy the great ocean that this Live is to it’s fullest!
The world I see through this sun visor...is shockingly pink!☆
This meat is super super tasty! What are you, a three-star chef?
Well then, now that our bellies are full, Imma go on a walk! Oh, you also wanna go with me? C’mon then~♪
Waves are just like our lives... They constantly crash and pull back again. ‘Da heck am I even saying here?
Eh? You’re gonna rest in the tent? W-Wait! I wanted to build a sandcastle together~!

The breeze feels so nice~♪ Lounging around, relaxing by the pool... isn’t this what any celeb aims for?
This grilled sausage looks amazingly good! *chomp chomp* Delish! I’ll have one more!
The view is breathtaking, huh? Yeah, I know. I’m so glad you’re enjoying the neon lights our facility is so proud of!
Aaaand, ‘cause you are my favorite customer...you’ve been given the chance of a night pic with me! Come on, move a bit clooser! You ready now? 3, 2, 1...
Oh, no! I’m gonna fall off the flamingooooo~!

My love for everyone is bigger than the sea!
For real, for real!
Soooo... How’s my swimsuit? From a celeb’s point of view, I even considered the angle of my hat~♪
Ugh, I’m all soaked... Wait a sec! Now I can do this one step further! Behold! My seaweed impression!
You defended the sausage with honor so it did not fall into the pool! An spectacular job, Flamingo!
Woahhh...the sky is full of stars~♪ Whoops! I almost fell again, ahaha...
Perfect opportunity for a night pic! Come’ere, let’s take this one together~♪
Let’s go on a sea adventure!
I'm gonna hook all your hearts in one fell swoop~♪
A salute to the magnificent sea!
No matter how rough the sea gets, I won’t lose! C’mon, let’s make some noise~!
This is the ultimate seafood Struggling Meal!
I’ll show you the most genius-like style of enjoying the ocean!
Should I splash you with water...? Nah, I won’t~♡
Thank you! Now, let’s start by stripping together~
That swimsuit is way too daring! If that’s how it is, then I’ll also have to go another step further...
Animal ears with a gyaru-like swimsuit, huh? I think you’ve unlocked your maximum potential!
I can’t get enough of her skin showing through the lace~♪
Grown-up?! What are ya trying to cook up next?
WHY NOT?! C’mon, shoot your water gun already!
Marine, want me to put some sunscreen on for you?
I'm going to make everyone fall head over heels in a sea of love~♡
That's so cold! Who pressed that on me just now?
Bae-chan, do the thing! Spin around like a whirlpool for me~!
This is Lamy’s... FULL THROTTLE MODE!
Don’t mess with other people’s swimsuits so roughly!
Sure~♪ Let’s depart for a tour to the depths of the ocean, just the two of us!
Hmm? What's with the fishing rod you're hiding behind your back?
The vibes are peak right now~♪ Don't miss out, let's goooo~!
What do you mean?! I really can’t keep up with the brain of a CEO...
But cheating is absolutely not allowed! My love is bigger than the ocean after all~♪
Omarun, that swimsuit is so cute~♪
W-What’s wrong, Omarun?! Wanna talk about it?!
Such an adult-like swimsuit~♪ Nice, nice~♪
By cutie, you mean me? Thank you!
UUUOOOOHHH! Lamy, you’re simply the beeest!
Lamy’s also got lots on herself~♪ Pom, poom~♪
Pushing the limits is fine, but at least think about the line you’re about to cross!
DON!!! Welcome to the birth of the gyaru-swimsuit-wearing fennec!
The sea doesn’t just heal your heart...it heals your soul too.
This sun visor is totally rad, rite?
Oh! A wild Rain Shaman! Maybe I'll catch her!
If we want a massive haul, we're gonna need a fresh, feisty rat for bait...
Engine to max! Ririka, can you like, keep up with this gal?!
Me, me, me! Have a sea date with me. Please, please, please!
Hm? I'm getting the feeling a naughty little kid is after my tail accessories.
Hahaha! At this rate, I might as well just roll across the ocean!
Let’s fire things up so it feels like the whole sea is boiling up~♪
The engine’s fire mustn’t go out! We’ve gotta enjoy the great ocean that this Live is to it’s fullest!
Everyone’s waiting for the boss’s orders!
Yes, yes, yes! Ririka’s the best!
YEEEEESHHHH! Lamy-tan, please look this waaaay!
Ayo! Wanna go on a date with me?♪
It’s not just the sun visor... The swimsuit is amazing on another whole level too.
Ayo! Question for y’all! Who wants to go on a date with me?
The genius and the brains...on stage!
E-Eh? Now? This is a stage, you know?!
Hehe! It's a plastic bottle, ehe! Want some water?
I'm a good kid, you know? I won't do anything~
Ooh~ You've got a cheeky look on you, Polpol~ Let's make mischief together!
Let's sing together, Ririka! Hurry, hurry!
A whirlpool...? Not sure where you're going with this, but here goes! Spin~!
Yooo, the crowd is going absolutely wild~!
P-Polka-senpai?! Why are you staring at me like that~?!
Whoa, sick! Polka-senpai is actually ball-balancing~!
Alright... Time to show 'em what we've actually got, shall we?
Oop! Looks like a fan is clutching their chest in agony over there~!
UUUOOH! As a CEO, I can’t fall behind!
Lamy-senpai’s elegance is the color of blue... So it’s gotta be the ocean, right?
You’ve got it! I’ll show you what I’m made of!
Lives are amazing~♪ Hype and vibes all around!
I made extra sure to get all my hair removal done perfectly, too!
Fufufu~♪ This is the CEO’s style, Lamy-senpai!
Everyone! Are your engines up to the task?! ‘Cause we revving up!
Yeah, but first...I’m gonna drench everyone with water!
Waaah?! Don't pull on my cardigan like that!
Heh. Guess it’s finally time to drop this 50kg hat...
Maybe I’ll put on some sunglasses and show you the grown-up me!
Hey there, cutie! Wanna hop on the CEO’s boat?
I'm pretty stylish with a hat on too, right?
Let’s have a water fight, Koyo-chan-senpai!
Give me everything you've got! Shout until the waves break apart!
My love for everyone is bigger than the sea! For real, for real!

In the <color=#ff3bc8>Point Rally Event</color>, you can earn Event Pts and Event Badges from Lives and Minigames!

You can collect Event Badges and exchange them for Event Memories and items at the Exchange.

The <color=#ff3bc8>more points you score, the more Event Pts and Event Badges</color> you'll earn.

▼Earning Event Pt/Event Badges 
・Using Auto Live is also valid
・The more Live Boosts you use, the bigger the rewards
・The longer the Song, the more you will earn
